objects: declared attacking creature with printed Melee
distinct opponents directly attacked by creatures
timing: the complete attack declaration is sealed before the opponent count and triggers are committed
choices: the active player orders simultaneous triggers through the ordinary trigger subsystem
apnap: all occurrences from one sealed transition are grouped once
layers: the resolving +N/+N modifier is an identity-locked layer 7c effect until end of turn
copy: only trusted typed current ability fragments participate
control_change: the source controller at trigger creation controls the triggered ability
zone_change: a changed source logical identity receives no modifier
source_leaves: the ability resolves but has no affected object after its source changes zones

known_blockers: conditional and rules-text-equivalent Melee wording remains unsupported
granted, copied, and face-down Melee requires trusted typed ability fragments
put-attacking effects and attack costs that remove a declared attacker remain outside this bounded capability
trigger-doubling policies remain outside this bounded capability
